content: Yowane Papthayso uma mathaman
Senawbi thonara thanamun Galilayaw mabaygaw kuykulnga nel Erodh. Nuydh kulay uma mathamadhin Yoewane Papthayso. Kalanu nungu Erodhan puziw mabaygal nubepa kedha, Yesun adhapudhay zageth mina koeyza.
Nuy Erodh kedha, ‘In nuy lak Yoewane Papthayso umangu kaday tharayngu. Nuy kedha zoenguz koey poerapoeralnga senawbi zagethoepa.’

Wagel kay mura thabi zapul, Erodh nuydh kulay Yoewane Papthayson kunumay lagoepa gasamoedhin, kuyk nuydh nungu tukuypaw ipi nubepa madhin. Nanu nel Erodhiyas. Na kulay Erodhan tukuypaw ipi, Pilipan ipi.
Yoewane nuy Erodhalpa umepu kedha, ‘Ngipel kedha maygi, sena wati pawa, ngidh nan niyaypa yoelpaypa.’ Na Erodhiyas Yoewanelngu ubigasidhin a kalanu nuydh Erodh zeyloenu kunumoedhin Yoewanen.
Erodh nuydh buwayl thayadhin nubepa umamathamoeypa, kasa kay kedha nuy akan. Minguz kedha, mura Yoewdhayalgaw mabaygal kedha, ‘Nuy Yoewane peropetha.’
Wara goeyga nanga Erodhan kazimay thonar, nungu ipiw Erodhiyasana ngoewakaz kazi matha nanu kusayg girel adhar Erodh a mura nungu mabaygal parunu. Nubepa mina kapu ngoedhalnga. Nungu dhiw koeyza.
Nuy nabepa kedha, ‘Ngaw yawoedhayzinga ngibepa kedha, ngi mizapa ubin mepa nanga, moegina za lawnga koey za, ngath ngaru aymoene ngibepa.’

Kalanu nanu apu nabepa kedha, ‘Ngi kedha zapa yapupoeybepa, Yoewane Papthayson kuyk kedha thonar beseninu kay muynu aral.’ Wa, na ngoewakaz yapupoeybaydhin. Erodh na gasamoedhin kedha, nuydh koerkak badh gasamoedhin, kasa kay kedha nubepa koey zageth nungu yawoedhayzinga patidaypa mura mabaygaw parunu.
Nuy kedha zoenguz nungu koewbu mabayg wayadhin. Nuy koewbu mabaygan nuyn Yoewanen kuyk patidhadhin a ngapa aradhin besininu muynu. Poeybadhin nanga ngoewakazipa, nadh nanu amalpa madhin nungu kuyk.
Kalanu nungu Yoewanen niyaykazil Erodhalpa memayidhin, nungu gamu madhin, moeramathayadhin. Kalanu thana Yesulpa nuyn yadu palgadhin.
Koeygarsar mabaygaw aygud

Yesu karngemidhin nanga senabi yangu wakay, nuy pathaydhin butanu. Kalanu nuy matha nungu kusayg bupapa, mabaygoegi dhadhabuthoepa. Mura mabaygal nanga karngemidhin kedha, nuy pathaydhin, koeygarsar mabaygal mura sethabi goegathoengu gimiya ladhun nubiya wagel.
Nuydh war doegam buwadh gasamoedhin nanga, mabaygaw moeyay imadhin, nungu thanamulpa koeyma koerkak badh gasamoedhin. Nuydh thanamun kikirilgal buth pathamoeydhin.

Senabi kutapa nanga nungu niyaykazil nubepa ladhudhin a mulemidhin kedha, ‘Goeyga pawpa mizin, ina mina mabaygoegi lag aypa barpudaypa. Ngidh mura mabaygal adhapa wayamoeyn, thanamulpa thanamun kutaw aypa barpudaypa, soeyzi wara goegathoengu.’
Nuy Yesu kuniya, ‘Lawnga thana matha kow, ngitha thanamulpa ayde mamayipa.’
Thana mulemidhin kuniya, ‘Ngoeymuniya matha payb bredal a ukasar wapil, mabayg mina koeygarsar.’
Yesu lak mulaydhin thanamulpa, ‘Lawnga, ngitha aydel ngayapa mamayiw.’

Kalanu Yesu sethabi payb kunaw susul kusuman a ukasar wapi, nuy kalanu daparpa kadaypa nagaydhin a Awgadhoepa eso poeybaydhin. Nuydh kunaw susul kope tidamoeyn a nungu niyay kazipa kusuman thanamulpa mabaygoepa poeybaypa, a nuydh lak ukasar wapi kedha mamaman mura mabaygoepa. Wa, thana niyay kazil mura poeybamoeydhin.

Thana mura balbayginga maytha yoeruylnga, senabi ay purthadhin, na kulay kasa moegina, kasa kay kedha ay muynu koey garsar, Awgadhan senabi moegina ay kedha madhin, thana niyay kazin thadha wanayzimayn toewaylob mura liday aymoeydhin ayngu
Thanamun mabaygaw garsar kedha, matha garkazil 5,000. Yoepkazil a moegina kazil lak koeygarsar.
Yesun mab woerab gimiya

Sew kalanu nanga nuydh nungu niyay kazil wayamoeydhin butiya. Thana nubiya kulay war doegam buwadhoepa, goegath nel Bethsayda. Nuy mabaygoepa mura mulaydhin senabi thonara kedha, ‘Ladhu.’ Wa, thana mura ladhudhin kalanu.
Kalanu matha nuy padiya kadaypa walaydhin, thoeythupoegaypa. Kubilu nanga matha nuy nungu kusayg si gimal, thaythupoegayn.
Thanamun niyaykaziw but koeysigal adhal balthayar, gub thanamulpa koeyza, butapa yawarpa gegeyadh.
Goeyga na amadhan nanga, Yesu thanamulpa uzaraydhin, nungu mab matha woerab gimiya.
Thana niyaykazil na imadhin nuyn, thanamun aka koeyza. Thana kedha, ‘A! Mari senaw boey!’ Thana gima gudiya wal tiduman, kuyk thanamun aka.
Yesu balbayginga muliz thanamulpa senabi thonar. Nuy kedha, ‘Ngitha akan maygi, in ngay.’
Kalanu Petheru nubepa mulaydhin kedha, ‘Kuykulnga, senaw mina ngi a? Ngidh ngoena ngibepa mar, ngay kay lak kedha gimiya woerab uzaripa ngi midh nanga.’
Yesu kedha, ‘Wa aya ngayapa.’ Kalanu Petheru adhapa pagadhin butangu, Yesulpa mab uzaraydhin woerab gimiya.
Maboenu nuydh koey gubalnga imadhin nungu purkan, nuydh aka gasamoedhin, nuy dudupaydhin mulupa woerab. Nuy walmiyaydhin kedha, ‘Kuykulnga, ngoena gasamar, ngawngu dudupoeyle.’
Yesu balbayginga nuyn gasamadhin, nubepa mulaydhin kedha, ‘Nginu kapu akasin kasa moegina, ngidh midh paru mina yapathamayginga?’
Kalanu palay patimoedhin butanu. Balbayginga senabi thonar gub koeyma mulupa pudhadhin.
Thana niyaykazil si butanu mina thawmadhin nuyn Yesun kedha, ‘Ngi Mina Awgadhaw Kazi.’
Yesu kikirilgal buth pathamoeypu sey Genesarethoenu
Kalanu thana wara dagam buwadhoepa thardhadhin, goegath nel Genesareth.
Sew goegathaw mabaygan nuyn imadhin nanga thana ngulaygal kedha nuy Yesu. Kalanu thana mura yadu palgadhin thanamun igalgal mura senabi doegumuya, a thana thanamun kikirilgal Yesulpa mamayidhin.

Mabayg mina koeygarsar, thana nubepa koeyma apasimir. Thana kedha nubepa, thanamulpa lak matha ngoedhagidh kedha thana nungu koey sodhaw kuth gasaman. Mura thana ngaya nanga nungu koey sodhaw kuth gasaman thana balbaygoesimoeyr senabi thonar.
